{{Quote|They're heading for the Medical Frigate.|Wedge Antilles, during the Battle of Endor|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
The '''''Redemption''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Fleet]]. Originally a standard Nebulon-B frigate, it was heavily modified to serve as the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] primary [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was fitted with the most advanced medical equipment available, including [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]], operating theaters capable of treating multiple [[Species/Legends|species]], and a full complement of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]]. The ''Redemption'' could treat up to 745 patients simultaneously and 98% made a full recovery, with most returning to duty within days. These changes came at the expense of its defensive capabilities, with several of the vessel's weapons removed, along with its [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement.

The ship traveled with the Alliance Fleet, often into [[Space warfare/Legends|combat situations]], and saw action several times, including the [[Ison Corridor ambush]], the [[Battle of Eidoloni]], and the [[Battle of Kothlis]]. Following his [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] received treatment aboard the ''Redemption'' at the [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Rebel rendezvous point]]. It later joined the Alliance Fleet gathering near [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] in preparation to assault the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. However, the ''Redemption'' was destroyed during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] when the rogue [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]], secretly in control of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], used the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] against it.

==Description==
===Design and propulsion===
The ''Redemption'' was originally a standard [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]. Like all [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of its class, the ''Redemption'' was 300 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="SWTJ3" /> 72 meters wide, and 166 meters high,<ref name="TOSAVC38-LC" /> and comprised a main section connected to a smaller propulsion module by a slender neck.<ref name="SWTJ3" /> Though originally designed to escort [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]], the vessel later underwent a number of modifications to allow it to serve as a dedicated [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]].<ref name="NEGVV" />

The ''Redemption'' had an array of seven [[Galaxy-15 ion engine/Legends|Galaxy-15 ion engines]], located at the rear of the propulsion module,<ref name="TOSAVC38-LC" /> together with a Class 2 [[Triple Taim/Legends|Triple Taim]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] for [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel.<ref name="BTM" /> The [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]] made it capable of achieving acceleration of 1,200 G in a [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] and a maximum speed of 800 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]] in an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]<ref name="NEGVV" /> or forty [[Megalight|MGLT]].<ref name="BTM" /> The ''Redemption''{{'s}} aft section also housed its [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]] and [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] tanks, along with main engineering and the chief engineer's quarters. A pair of [[Static discharge vane/Legends|static discharge vanes]] were located underneath the propulsion module.<ref name="SWTJ3" />

The main [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] was approximately half way up the main section, facing in the direction of the ship's travel,<ref name="SWTJ3" /> and featured a raised command platform.<ref name="CV" /> A meeting room was located near the bridge,<ref name="SW1" /> as were quarters for both officers and passengers, which were positioned on the decks above it. A series of [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] shafts allowed movement between decks in both the main and propulsion sections, while an access corridor ran through the connecting engineering boom, permitting the crew to move between the two sections.<ref name="SWTJ3" />

Due to the limited resources available to the Alliance, Rebel starships had to be flexible enough to serve in multiple roles. As a result, the ''Redemption'' was fitted with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and communications equipment to allow it to function as a a battle command base.<ref name="CV">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2013)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']]</ref> A primary [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]] was located on top of the main section,<ref name="SWTJ3" /> on the left side of the ship,<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> with a smaller short-range communications array positioned further aft. Forward and aft sensor units were located toward the bottom of this section,<ref name="SWTJ3" /> as was the main [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[ANs-9.5w wide range sensor system]].<ref name="TOSAVC38-IC" /> The ship's emergency [[Battery/Legends|batteries]] and recycling systems were located further up the main section.<ref name="SWTJ3" />

===Armament and docking facilities===
When it was first constructed, the ''Redemption'' was equipped with twelve [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries<ref name="CV" /> for use against [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]<ref name="NEGVV" /> and a further twelve [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]],<ref name="CV" /> which used precision tracking servos and advanced [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]] to target fast-moving [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="NEGVV" /> When it was refitted to serve as a medical [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], much of the ''Redemption''{{'s}} weaponry was removed to make way for medical facilities.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> Following the refit, the ''Redemption'' was left with six [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] [[XI7 Turbolaser/Legends|XI7 turbolasers]] and eight [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]] [[RH8 laser cannon/Legends|RH8 laser cannons]]. The primary forward turbolaser and [[Laser/Legends|laser]] cannon were located on the lower primary section of the ''Redemption''{{'s}} superstructure, covering the direction in which the ship was traveling,<ref name="SWTJ3" /> with an upper turbolaser turret postitioned on top of the main section towards the bow.<ref name="CV" /> Frigates such as the ''Redemption'', although well-armed, were vulnerable to [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighter]] attacks.<ref name="RS II guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:RedemptionSurgeryExterior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Exterior view of the ''Redemption''{{'s}} surgery suite]]
Nebulon-B frigates were often used as bases for [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter raids]]<ref name="RS II guide" /> and the ''Redemption'' originally had [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] space for two full [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. The starfighter launch bay was later transformed into a large medical facility,<ref name="CV" /> with much of the hangar space was taken up by [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]]<ref name="NEGVV" /> and recovery areas.<ref name="CCG-R">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=''Redemption''}}</ref> Although the ''Redemption'' could still carry a small number of starfighters&mdash;at least three [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]&mdash;<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref> it was left largely dependent on support ships to defend it during combat.<ref name="NEGVV" /> Small ships could still dock to transfer patients to and from the ''Redemption'' using one of several docking fixtures,<ref name="EGVV" /> including two retractable [[Docking tube/Legends|docking tubes]] located along the engineering boom and a casualty boarding bay in the main section.<ref name="SWTJ3" /> When going into combat situations, the ''Redemption'' could carry a limited number of starfighters attached to the docking tubes,<ref name="RSII" /> and the ship could continue to move through [[Realspace/Legends|space]] while another vessel was attached, pulling the smaller vessel along.<ref name="BTM" /> A dedicated cargo bay was located towards the bottom of the main section.<ref name="CV" />

The reduced weaponry and loss of a starfighter complement was compensated by the enhanced [[Delphus/Legends|Delphus]] [[JC-671 deflector shield generator/Legends|JC-671]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|generator]] on top of the propulsion module, a [[Serridge/Legends|Serridge]] [[SEAL Shielding System/Legends|SEAL shielding system]], and a [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]]-reinforced alloy hull.<ref name="BTM" /> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] also used the refit to install redundant systems, including backup [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], shield projectors, and [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems.<ref name="NEGVV" /> The vessel was equipped with two [[Phylon Transport/Legends|Phylon]] [[Q7 tractor beam projector/Legends|Q7 tractor beam projectors]],<ref name="SWTJ3" /> which could be used to rescue crippled friendly starfighters or capture disabled enemy ships.<ref name="NEGVV" /> The forward tractor beam was located at the bow of the ship.<ref name="CV" />

===Medical facilities===
[[File:RedemptionFalcon.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' attached to one of the ''Redemption''{{'s}} docking fixtures.]]
The ''Redemption'' had complete medical facilities, located on several decks in the main section,<ref name="SWTJ3" /> and containing the most sophisticated medical equipment available.<ref name="RAS">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> Central to the medical facilities were sixteen [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] tanks<ref name="NEGVV" /> for healing of skin injuries, including burns and lacerations. The bacta tanks enhanced the body's own ability to regenerate skin and muscle tissue, speeding up healing and preventing septic infections with little scarring or adhesion development. The bacta tanks were operated by [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]], while the ship's main medical [[Computer/Legends|computer]] monitored and timed treatments.<ref name="SWTJ3" /> Diagnostic computers and genetic reconstruction tools allowed the 2-1B droids to create [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthetics with tactile sensitivity to replace lost limbs.<ref name="CV" />

On the decks surrounding the bacta tanks were a cluster of intensive care units, operating theaters, and recovery wards to house the patients aboard the ship.<ref name="SWTJ3" /> Special facilities were available for non-[[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] breathers, including [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] [[Ammonia chamber|chambers]].<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> Quarters for medical personnel were located fore of the bacta tanks, as were the ship's [[Blood/Legends|blood]] banks, and its supply of fresh [[Water/Legends|water]] was located nearby. The ''Redemption'' had its own morgue and laboratories<ref name="SWTJ3" /> capable of analyzing and containing pathogens,<ref name="CV" /> as well as a dedicated section for storing medical equipment<ref name="SWTJ3" /> and up to 6,000 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of related cargo.<ref name="BTM" />

The ''Redemption''{{'s}} range of medical facilities allowed most injuries and conditions to be treated aboard. At full capacity, the ship had enough beds to treat 745 patients simultaneously with minimal waiting time for facilities, and achieved higher recovery rates than many [[Planet/Legends|planetside]] [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]]&mdash;almost 98% of patients made a full recovery and most were ready to return to duty within a couple of days.<ref name="SWTJ3" />

==History==
===Early service===
{{Quote|As quickly as I could, I locked up and fired on the other two Bombers. I knew that I couldn't afford a miss because my computer told me that the ''Warspite'' had returned to normal space&mdash;on the side of the Medical Frigate opposite me&mdash;and it was launching more TIEs!|Keyan Farlander, from his [[After-action report/Legends|after-action report]] on the skirmish near Brigia|<ref name="X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide">''[[X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>}}
Kuat Drive Yards originally developed the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], to help defend Imperial convoys from attack by Rebel starfighters. However, due to Rebel capture operations, along with defections by Imperial forces, many of the frigates came to be part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. The ships proved vital for the Alliance in many early campaigns, but as the Rebels acquired larger vessels, the Nebulon-Bs were converted for other uses, including [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]], long-range reconnaissance and search, and rescue frigates.<ref name="EGVV" /> The ''Redemption'' was one of the converted frigates<ref name="SWTJ3" /> and, by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBY">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] begins after the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] entered service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' establishes that the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Leia Organa]] occurs at the end of ''Star Wars: X-Wing''{{'s}} second tour of duty. Organa's capture takes place on 35:3:3 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system, placing it at the beginning of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to [[Template:YearMathGRS|the following explanation]]. Events in ''Star Wars: X-Wing'' before the end of the second tour of duty therefore take place in 1 BBY.</ref> was one of at least two Nebulon-Bs serving as medical frigates in the Alliance Fleet.<ref name="XW">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> The Alliance considered medical attention at the site of conflict to be a high priority, so the ''Redemption'' traveled with the Fleet, often directly into combat situations. The ship soon proved its worth in helping to save the lives of many Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and crew,<ref name="SWTJ3" /> and was considered one of the hardest working vessels in the Alliance Fleet.<ref name="TOSAVC38" />

[[File:RedemptionHangar-SW1.jpg|thumb|left|180px|X-wings land in the ''Redemption''{{'s}} hangar.]]
In 1 BBY,<ref name="1BBY" /> the ''Redemption'' hosted wounded personnel who survived the [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|evacuation]] of [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]] during the early stages of the [[Operation Strike Fear]], a major Imperial offensive aimed at eliminating the Rebellion. The majority of the wounded arrived aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Korolev]]'', with three [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] from [[Medevac]] group bringing the rest. Four X-wings from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] were assigned to provide cover for the transfer of wounded to the ''Redemption''.<ref name="XW" />

The transfer was [[Skirmish near Brigia|interrupted]] by the arrival of the Imperial Nebulon-B frigate [[Warspite (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Warspite'']], which launched one wave of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] and one of TIE fighters before jumping back to hyperspace. The defending starfighters moved to engage the incoming Imperials, but the ''Warspite'' soon returned on the other side of the ''Redemption'' and launched an additional wave of both types of TIE, hoping to catch the Rebels out of position.<ref name="XW" /> Red Squadron, and particularly [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], by ignoring the personal threat of the TIE fighters to eliminate the TIE bombers attacking the ''Korolev'', were able to eliminate the Imperials and protect the transfer. After the ''Korolev'' followed the shuttles in delivering the wounded, the Rebel ships escaped into hyperspace.<ref name="XW:OSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> The mission was later recreated as a [[Flight simulator/Legends|training scenario]] for [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilots. Though officially known as the "[[Redemption scenario|''Redemption'' scenario]]," the difficulty of saving the ''Korolev'' led many pilots to refer to it as the "''Requiem'' scenario."<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>

===The new Rebel base===
{{Quote|We're almost out of this mess. If we can just make it through this nebula, we're all clear.''"<br />"''I've got a bad feeling about this.|The ''Redemption''{{'s}} captain and Luke Skywalker during the Ison Corridor ambush|audio=RedemptionCaptain-RS2.flac|<ref name="RSII" />}}
After the Alliance destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], they were forced to evacuate their [[Great Temple/Legends|base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. While it traveled with the Alliance Fleet in early [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the ''Redemption'' was used as a base of operations for the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]-turned-Rebel [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and the X-wings of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] as they scouted the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] for a suitable location for a new base. Alliance [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] visited the ship around this time to discuss the search with Organa.<ref name="SW1" />

At some point during the Galactic Civil War, the ''Redemption'' made a supply run to the planet [[Morton (planet)|Morton]]. While making the return journey, the ship picked up a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] and its crew decided to investigate. The ''Redemption'' emerged from hyperspace to find the wreckage of an Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and a single [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Although the frigate's commander suspected a trap, Organa ordered that the escape pod be brought aboard. The pod's passenger was [[Silam Dunerz]], who claimed his ship was ambushed by [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and that he was seeking to defect to the Alliance. Moments after he was brought aboard the ''Redemption'', however, the ship was [[Skirmish aboard the Redemption|attacked]] by the pirates, who boarded it in an attempt to steal its cargo. Although Dunerz helped to repel the pirates, he had set up the attack in an attempt to gain Organa's trust and capture her for the Empire. When his deception was exposed, he was taken into custody.<ref name="LT">{{SWComicCite|7.12|Leia's Trust}}</ref>

[[File:RedemptionIsonCorridor-RSII.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Redemption'' leads a Rebel convoy through the Ison Corridor.]]
The Rebels eventually chose the remote ice world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to act as their new [[Echo Base/Legends|headquarters]]. Soon after Echo Base was established, the ''Redemption'', along with three members of Red Squadron, including Skywalker and Antilles, joined a convoy of six [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] carrying supplies to the new base.<ref name="RSII" /> The ''Redemption'' served as the command ship for the convoy.<ref name="RS II guide" /> The convoy was due to rendezvous with another convoy in the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] before proceeding to Hoth, but emerged from hyperspace to discover that the other convoy had been destroyed. Despite the possibility of attack, the convoy was unable to jump straight back into hyperspace, and needed to move through the debris field first. However, it soon came under [[Ison Corridor ambush|attack]] by TIE fighters,<ref name="RSII" /> which moved against the Rebel [[Transport/Legends|transports]] from three different directions.<ref name="RS II guide" /> Red Squadron was able to defeat the first wave of TIEs, but with more incoming, they docked with the ''Redemption'' to swap their X-wings for the faster [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] that were being transported aboard. The second wave of TIEs was soon destroyed and the convoy entered a nearby [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], beyond which they would be able to enter hyperspace. However, the convoy came under further attack from [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] in the nebula, before the ''Redemption'' finally emerged and fled into hyperspace with the other surviving convoy ships.<ref name="RSII" />

===The Empire strikes back===
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Rebels were again forced on the run after their defeat at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The ''Redemption'' joined the remnants of the Alliance Fleet at their [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]],<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> beyond the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], above the galactic equatorial plane. Among those treated aboard the ship at this time were Luke Skywalker and the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]].<ref name="OPF" /> Zuckuss, together with his partner [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], had helped rescue ninety Rebels from the GR-75 medium transport [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']], which had been disabled while escaping Hoth. In exchange, the Rebels agreed to treat the [[Breather Gand|ammonia-breathing]] Gand for damage caused to his [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] by oxygen inhalation. After the group arrived aboard the [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']], the medical droids [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]] and [[FX-7/Legends|FX-7]] rushed Zuckuss to the surgical bay, before 2-1B was called away to assist with Skywalker's operation. Working inside a special ammonia chamber, medical droids were able to regrow the damaged tissue inside Zuckuss, giving him functioning lungs within just a few days of the operation.<ref name="OPF" /> For her part in ensuring that the ''Bright Hope'' survivors made it safely back to the Alliance, Echo Base's chief communications officer, [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]], was awarded the [[Kalidor Crescent/Legends|Kalidor Crescent]] and a promotion to [[Commander/Legends|commander]]<ref name="Insider74">{{InsiderCite|74|Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth}}</ref> in a ceremony led by General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] aboard the ''Redemption''.<ref name="OPF" />

[[File:RedemptionInterior.png|thumb|left|300px|Luke Skywalker is treated aboard the ''Redemption''.]]
After fleeing Hoth, Skywalker had lost his hand in a [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="ESB" /> He arrived at the rendezvous point aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', having already had his condition stabilized using the ship's medical bed, and was taken to the ''Redemption''{{'s}} microsurgery room. There, a team of [[neurospecialist]]s and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], including 2-1B, replaced his severed hand with a biosynthetic prosthetic.<ref name="SWTJ3" /> 2-1B suggested that it might have been possible to perform a more effective procedure at some point in the future, but that Skywalker would have to make do with the prosthetic until then. Nevertheless, Skywalker was able to return to duty soon after the operation<ref name="ESB radio">[[The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''The Empire Strikes Back'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref> and was using his new hand just as well as his old one within two days.<ref name="SWTJ3" /> As 2-1B carried out the final attachment of the prosthetic, Skywalker was visited by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who was due to depart for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the ''Millennium Falcon'' in search of the captured Han Solo. The droid agreed to allow Skywalker, along with Leia Organa, to observe the departure of the ''Millennium Falcon'' from the surgery suite window.<ref name="ESB radio" />

Skywalker and Organa remained on the ''Redemption'' after the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} departure while he recovered from his surgery.<ref name="ESB" /> They were still aboard when the Rebels were [[Skirmish at Haven|discovered]] by an Imperial [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]]<ref name="SOTE1">[[Shadows of the Empire 1|''Shadows of the Empire'' 1]]</ref> within hours of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} departure.<ref name="TotGD">''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]''</ref> The Rebels could not afford to allow the Empire to learn of their location, and so they jammed the enemy ship's communications while [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] moved to intercept it. Rogue Squadron was able to eliminate the enemy vessel before it could escape to report their location, but the Rebels decided to alter course as a precaution.<ref name="SOTE1" />

===Alliance on the run===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Liberty'', this is the ''Redemption''! We're under attack. We're being pinned down by an Interdictor and can't hyper!"<br />"''Redemption'', this is the ''Liberty''. Help is on the way.|Kupalo and [[Yamarus/Legends|Yamarus]]|audio=KupaloYamarus-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:Redemption_aft_btm.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Aft view of the ''Redemption''{{'s}} engines]]
Following the retreat from Hoth, the ''Redemption'' became part of the [[Liberty Task Force|task force]] led by the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']]. During this time, the Alliance received several transmissions from an Imperial informant, one Commander [[Zaletta]], who eventually provided them with his location, aboard [[DX-11a|Outpost DX-11a]] in the [[Eidoloni system/Legends|Eidoloni system]], and announced his intention to defect. [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] dispatched Commander [[Kupalo]] aboard the ''Redemption'' to rendezvous with Zaletta and discuss the terms of his defection. The ''Redemption'' was escorted to the rendezvous point by four X-wings from Red Squadron, and remained there while its escort proceeded to DX-11a and created a diversion, allowing Zaletta to escape aboard the shuttle ''[[AA-23]]''. After returning to the rendezvous point, ''AA-23'' docked in the ''Redemption''{{'s}} hangar and the frigate prepared to return to the ''Liberty''. However, before it could jump to hyperspace, the ''Redemption'' was ambushed by the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Restrainer]]'' and the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Imperial II-class)|''Subjugator'']]. Kupalo placed Zaletta in custody and called the ''Liberty'' to assist. After the ''Liberty'' arrived, the Rebel forces were able to [[Battle of Eidoloni|destroy]] the ''Restrainer'' and allow the ''Redemption'' to return safely to the Rebel Fleet. It later emerged that Zaletta's defection was genuine and that it was Kupalo, having been previously captured and brainwashed, who had summoned the Imperial forces to the rendezvous.<ref name="XWA" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter{{!}}Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power}}
Around the same time, the Alliance was [[Spreading the Rebellion|seeking to establish]] a new base of operations in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the Outer Rim Territories. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] soon dispatched a [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|task force]] to search the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] for the Rebel forces, forcing the Alliance to evacuate their bases in the outlying regions. While evacuating the [[Hormuuz]] facility near [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]], the Rebels came under [[Evacuation of Gelgelar|heavy attack]] from Imperial forces. Although the Alliance successfully evacuated the [[XQ5 Platform|station's]] crew, many of them suffered serious injuries during the heavy bombardment inflicted on the [[Space station/Legends|station]]. The ''Redemption'' was promptly dispatched to rendezvous with their transports, so the injured could be treated before joining the other Rebel forces gathering in the sector.<ref name="XvT">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''</ref>

The rendezvous point was selected in an isolated area, far from most inhabited [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and Imperial patrol routes. Even so, the Rebels took no chances and assigned Rogue and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadrons]] to fly cover in [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] while the wounded were transferred to the ''Redemption''. The wounded soon arrived aboard the GR-75 medium transports ''[[T-37]]'', ''[[T-38]]'', and ''[[T-39]]'', along with the ''Lambda''-class shuttle ''[[Compassion]]'' and medical supplies on the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lanigiro]]'', but the transfer operation was [[Skirmish near Gelgelar|interrupted]] by the arrival of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Nemesis]]''. The Star Destroyer launched starfighters to destroy the transports as they docked with the ''Redemption'', but Rogue and Gold Squadrons were able to hold them off long enough for all the patients to be moved to the hospital ship and for the Rebel ships to escape into hyperspace.<ref name="XvT" />
{{Endgame}}

===The second Death Star===
[[File:Rebel_fleet_ESB.jpg|thumb|left|290px|The ''Redemption'' travels with the Alliance Fleet.]]
Later that year, the Rebels learned that the Empire was constructing a [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. A Rebel operation was able to capture the [[Death Star II plans|plans]] to the new [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], which were taken aboard the CR90 corvette [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']]. The ''Redemption'', escorted by Rogue Squadron in [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]], was sent to rendezvous with the ''Razor'' near [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] and escort it safely to Alliance High Command. They arrived to find the ''Razor'' already under [[Battle of Kothlis|attack]] from the ''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer [[Motivator/Legends|''Motivator'']], and Rogue Squadron moved to destroy the Imperial vessel. The Imperials responded by attacking the ''Redemption'',<ref name="RSII" /> but Rogue Squadron was able to eliminate the Star Destroyer's shields and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] before destroying its bridge,<ref name="RS II guide" /> causing the ''Motivator'' to crash onto the planet below.<ref name="RSII" />

The captured information revealed that the second Death Star was being constructed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] and that the battlestation's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] was not yet operational, its only defense being a deflector shield projected from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] below. Furthermore, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was known to be personally overseeing the final stages of construction, presenting the Rebels with an opportunity to deal a major blow to the Empire.<ref name="ROTJ" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Alliance began to gather their forces near [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] in preparation to attack the Death Star.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The ''Redemption'' was one of the last ships to head to the rallying point, as part of the [[Independence task force|task force]] led by the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]. The task force encountered a number of Imperial patrols on the way as the Empire conducted a major search for the Rebels. For the final leg of the journey, the group was to [[Battle of Sullust (4 ABY)|rendezvous]] with A-wings from the ''Liberty'' that would escort them the rest of the way. However, the escort was delayed after assisting the [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']]{{'s}} group as it came under Imperial attack and, by the time they arrived, the ''Redemption'' and the other ships in the task force had come under attack from the Star Destroyers ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'', [[Protector (Victory II-class)|''Protector'']], and [[Vanguard (Victory II-class)|''Vanguard'']]. While the A-wings moved to clear the area of the enemy TIEs, particularly the TIE bombers that were launching [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] toward the ''Independence'', [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], aboard the ''Independence'', ordered B-wings to launch and counterattack the Star Destroyers. The Rebel fighters were able to hold the Imperials back long enough for the task force ships, including the ''Redemption'', to escape to hyperspace.<ref name="XWA" />

[[File:RedemptionEndor1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Redemption'' is attacked by TIE interceptors during the Battle of Endor.]]
Soon after the last of the Rebel ships arrived at the rendezvous point, a [[Endor strike team/Legends|commando team]], led by General Han Solo, set off to Endor to destroy the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] protecting the Death Star. The Alliance Fleet followed soon after to begin their assault.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The ''Redemption'' joined the fleet for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], going into combat despite its classification as a medical frigate.<ref name="RSII" /> However, the Rebels arrived to find that they had been lured into a trap&mdash;the Death Star's shields were still up, its [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser|primary weapon]] was already operational, and a full fleet of Star Destroyers waited to eliminate the Rebels.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The medical frigate came under attack from numerous TIE interceptors and several TIE bombers,<ref name="RSII" /> but quick action by the ''Millennium Falcon'' and the X-wings of Red Squadron saved it from destruction.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Ultimately, however, the ''Redemption'' was obliterated<ref name="TOSAVC38" /> by the second Death Star's powerful superlaser, secretly controlled by the bounty hunter [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]].<ref name="SW:CL1">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> Despite the loss of the ''Redemption'', Solo's team was finally able to bring down the shields, allowing Rebel starfighters to enter the Death Star's superstructure, destroying the battlestation.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Redemption'' had a full staff of eighty medical personnel. Rebel medics were highly trained in the field treatment of common injuries, including [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] wounds, chemical poisoning, fractures, and vacuum exposure. The medics could stabilize most serious wounds until the patient could be seen by one of the ship's specialists, such as its team of neurospecialists, or by one of its thirty medical droids,<ref name="BTM" /> all of which were programmed to treat trauma patients.<ref name="CV" /> In addition to the medical staff, the ship had a crew of 850, comprising seventy-seven officers and 773 enlisted personnel,<ref name="SWTJ3" /> sixty-six [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]], and seventy-five [[Rebel trooper/Legends|troops]].<ref name="BTM" /> The ''Redemption'' was [[Captain/Legends|commanded]] by a [[Redemption captain|female captain]] from some point prior to the Battle of Hoth until its destruction at the Battle of Endor.<ref name="RSII" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MedicalFrigateConcept-TMOTESB.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Early concept sketch of the ''Redemption'']]
The ''Redemption'' was created for the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], as one of two Rebel medical frigates, along with the [[Salvation (medical frigate)|''Salvation'']]. In the game, the ''Redemption'' appears in the fourth mission of Tour of Duty 1, "Protect Medical Frigate," which requires players to eliminate waves of TIE bombers approaching the frigate from opposite directions while a series of Rebel ships dock with it.<ref name="XW" /> The difficulty of the mission can be reduced by exploiting a loophole in the game&mdash;only the ''Korolev'' is required to dock successfully and players can make it dock with the ''Redemption'' more quickly by ordering the shuttles to jump to hyperspace at the start of the mission.<ref name="XW:OSG" /> Author [[Michael A. Stackpole]] included a training scenario based on the ''X-Wing'' mission in his [[1996]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''.<ref name="XW" /><ref name="XW:RS" />

The [[Cloud City Limited]] and [[Death Star II Limited]] expansion sets to the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] by [[Decipher]], along with the [[1998]] LucasArts interactive CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'', later revealed that the ''Redemption'' was the previously unnamed medical frigate that first appeared in [[Irvin Kershner]]'s [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and that this was the same vessel that later appeared in the [[1983]] sequel, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], directed by [[Richard Marquand]].<ref name="BTM" /><ref name="ESB" /><ref name="CCG-R" /><ref name="ROTJ" /><ref name="CCG-HRTMF">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Heading For The Medical Frigate}}</ref>

[[File:RedemptionModel-SWC.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Construction of the Redemption model for Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back]]
As production of ''The Empire Strikes Back'' neared completion, ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] decided that a new ship model was needed and tasked the model shop with creating the medical frigate on [[October 1]], [[1979]]. [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] produced an initial concept sketch for the ship,<ref name="TMOTESB">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> which, at Lucas's suggestion, was designed to resemble an [[Wikipedia:Outboard motor|outboard motor]]. Early designs of the ''Redemption'' called for subdued colors and a heavily aged look to the ship's hull.<ref name="BTM" /> Rodis-Jamero's final design was approved and turned over to the model shop to be turned into a three-dimensional model.<ref name="TMOTESB" /> One of the last models to be created for the film and only identified as the "Rebel medical frigate star cruiser,"<ref name="TOSAVC38-MM">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|38|Movie Magic}}</ref> the model measured 50 x 247 x 99 centimeters and was part constructed from plastic model kits, including miniature boat hulls, a [[Wikipedia:B-29 Superfortress|B-29 Superfortress]] fuselage, and [[Wikipedia:Aircraft carrier|aircraft carriers]]. The two halves of the ship were connected by a painted industrial [[Wikipedia:Polyvinyl chloride|PVC]] pipe. The shot of Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] looking through the surgery suite [[Window/Legends|window]] was achieved by using rear-projection photography.<ref name="BTM" />

[[File:CRUI001B.jpg|thumb|left|270px|''Redemption'' concept art]]
The ''Redemption'' also appeared in two sequels to ''Star Wars: X-Wing'', [[1997]]'s ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power Campaigns]]'' and [[1999]]'s ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''.<ref name="XWA" /><ref name="XvT" /> ''Balance of Power'' gave players the choice of flying for either the Rebel Alliance or the Galactic Empire as the two sides fight for control of the Airam sector. This article assumes that the Rebel campaign is the [[canon]]ical outcome.<ref name="XvT" />

There are some minor inconsistencies between sources describing the ''Redemption''. [[Starlog Communications International|''Starlog'']]{{'s}} [[1994]] third volume of the [[Star Wars Technical Journal of the Rebel Forces|''Star Wars Technical Journal'']] established that the ship carried fifteen bacta tanks, a figure that was also used in ''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' in 1996.<ref name="SWTJ3" /><ref name="EGVV" /> The [[2003]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' and [[2013]]'s [[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2013)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']], however, give the number of bacta tanks as sixteen.<ref name="NEGVV" /><ref name="CV" /> The ''Star Wars Technical Journal'' also placed the size of the ship's crew at 850, while the slightly larger number of 854 was used in ''Behind the Magic''.<ref name="SWTJ3" /><ref name="BTM" />
